provenance.scope: Original engine and screen/procedure code transpiled and run with React hooks, native UI, storage, auth data, DB, and SMS boundaries mocked. No real app install, DB query, network request, SMS, or homepage mutation.

results.name: Manifold-only flow valve always uses its discount price
Failed 10-port selection retains both the 4-port UI state and quotation
Deleting the manifold clears its selected-port prerequisite
Switching to a different technician/request cannot retain the previous draft
Nonfinite quantity input is rejected or normalized before reaching a quotation
An unauthenticated caller is denied without a database write
A customer role is denied without a database write
Submitted technician/branch IDs do not override the authenticated technician
Own-history handler supplies technician and source filters
Zero amount and malformed item JSON are rejected before persistence
A positive amount mismatching the line total is rejected
A report originating from request 42 preserves that request association
